name: rollmean.default
title: Rolling mean of a plain vector or matrix

origin.description: Rolling mean of a plain vector or matrix.
origin.usage: rollmean.default(x, k, fill = if (na.pad) NA, na.pad = FALSE, align = c("center", "left", "right"), ...)

arguments.name: k
arguments.text: Window width in observations. It is truncated toward zero.

arguments.name: fill
arguments.text: Three fill values for the left side, the interior gaps, and the right side. A shorter vector is recycled and a longer one keeps the first three. NULL drops those positions. "extend" repeats an end and linearly interpolates an interior gap.

arguments.name: align
arguments.text: Where the window sits on its result time: center, left, or right. A unique prefix is enough. NULL selects center.
Further arguments passed on to the series method.

origin.details: Wraps the plain values as a series, rolls the mean, and returns the values. An empty input is returned unchanged. The result is the values, without the index.
origin.value: The rolling mean, as a NumPy array for a plain series.

translation.description: Rolling mean of a plain vector or matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Vector or matrix. A Zoo is reduced to its values after the roll.

arguments.name: k
arguments.text: Window width in observations. It is truncated toward zero. This is k in R.

arguments.name: fill
arguments.text: Three fill values for the left side, the interior gaps, and the right side. A shorter vector is recycled and a longer one keeps the first three. NULL drops those positions. "extend" repeats an end and linearly interpolates an interior gap.

arguments.name: na_pad
arguments.text: Deprecated. True fills with NA. This is na.pad in R.

arguments.name: align
arguments.text: Where the window sits on its result time: center, left, or right. A unique prefix is enough. NULL selects center.

arguments.name: **kwargs
arguments.text: Further arguments passed on to the series method.

translation.details: Wraps the plain values as a series, rolls the mean, and returns the values. An empty input is returned unchanged. The result is the values, without the index.
translation.value: The rolling mean, as a NumPy array for a plain series.
translation.example:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/zoo")
import numpy as np
from zoo.roll import rollmean_default
print(" ".join(format(float(v), ".16g") for v in np.ravel(np.asarray(rollmean_default(np.arange(1, 9), 3)), order="F")))
